prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Continue to Quick Start", "Quick Desktop Controls", "Learn how to drag, right-click, and command your pet on your desktop.", "Finish Onboarding", "Right-click your pet for actions and settings", "Drag your pet to reposition it on screen"]
2: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pet", "Connecting your account enables automatic cloud backups so your pet profile is never lost.", "Cloud Save Enabled"]
3: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Create or choose an interactive pet that lives right on your desktop window.", "Get Started"]
4: ["Sign In to Save Your Companion", "Link your account now so your custom pets and unlocked items are preserved across sessions.", "Sign In with Account"]
5: ["Upload well-lit, centered photos for optimal 3D pet generation results.", "Avoid dark background lighting or low-resolution images."]
6: ["Rendering Your Desktop Pet", "Our engine is preparing your custom pet animations in the background."]
7: ["Your Companion is Ready", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen.", "If you do not see your pet immediately, check your system tray icon.", "Locate Pet on Screen"]
8: ["Choose Your Adoption Journey", "Select a ready-to-play pet or generate a custom companion from your photos."]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Name your new companion to register your adoption certificate.", "Includes Free Starter Accessory Pack"]
